invariants.rationale: tileSet is accessed with tileSet.getTile(...), so it should not be null for method correctness.
tile is dereferenced with tile.getId() in the method body, so it should not be null to avoid NullPointerExceptions.
tileElement.get("animation") is called, so tileElement should not be null for correct execution.
firstgid is used as a base offset when fetching tiles; typically, tile GIDs are non-negative.
The method casts tileSet.getTile(...) to StaticTiledMapTile, so the object should be a TiledMapTile instance or null.
